post.description:
Load many cases at once (e.g. from the court's existing system or the AI intake service).
Each case is validated and routed on its own: one bad row does not stop the others.

schema.title: Response Import Cases Cases Import Post

post.description: Attach more evidence to an existing case (filer with their case token, court staff, or the AI service).

patch.description: Cases are never deleted (legal record). Withdraw / close them with a status change; it is logged.

get.description: Serves the ORIGINAL file after re-checking its hash, and records the access in the custody chain.

Snapshot of the chain head. Save it somewhere the database admin cannot edit; pass it back to
/custody/verify/{id}?anchor_head=..&anchor_entries=.. to prove the whole log was not rebuilt.

AnchorOut.description:
Store this OUTSIDE the database (email, another system, a notary). Later pass it to /custody/verify to
prove the log was not rebuilt. `signature` is an HMAC (needs ANCHOR_SECRET or a staff token configured).

CaseCreatedOut.description: Only the POST /cases response carries this. Store it: it is shown once and cannot be recovered.
